meta.description: Interactive WhatsApp job search bot. Text the bot to search LinkedIn in real time. Commands: 'find [keywords]', 'find [keywords] in [location]', 'top', 'help'. SETUP: (1) Set Twilio credential. (2) In n8n, activate this workflow and copy the webhook URL shown on the Webhook node. (3) In Twilio console → Messaging → WhatsApp → Sandbox Settings, paste that URL into 'When a message comes in'. (4) Send 'join <your-sandbox-word>' to the Twilio sandbox number (+1 415 523 8886) from your WhatsApp to register your number.
